comment:
One source-backed edge case remains: opening the picker on an empty workspace can redirect the paste to a window on the previous workspace.

## A stale toplevel is not necessarily the picker’s origin

At `87f3010`, [`open()`](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/blob/87f3010663cd2a2f7e3c5d4ca7731c414f3abaca/shell/plugins/clipboard/Clipboard.qml#L46-L61) trusts `Hyprland.activeToplevel.address`. Quickshell’s [active-window handler](https://github.com/quickshell-mirror/quickshell/blob/1a4716cde794a59928d9d9fc15f2afc7a95de360/src/wayland/hyprland/ipc/connection.cpp#L557-L567) ignores an empty `activewindowv2` address without clearing that object. Switching from an open application to an empty workspace can therefore leave the old window as the captured target.

Source-traced sequence, not a live desktop reproduction:

```text
Window A on workspace 1 -> switch to empty workspace 2
                        -> open clipboard; target still A
                        -> Enter/click an entry
Base: copy entry; no focused application receives the paste
PR:   refocus A on workspace 1; paste into A
```

The helpers explicitly refocus the supplied address, and Hyprland’s [focus action](https://github.com/hyprwm/Hyprland/blob/efb50993780079460b0cbed1363e2166a2de1d9f/src/config/shared/actions/ConfigActions.cpp#L457-L474) switches workspace when necessary. This case requires the previous window to remain open and no new application to take focus.

**Impact:** Selecting text or an image from an empty workspace can unexpectedly switch back and insert it into an unrelated terminal or chat input. Copy-only selection is unaffected.

**Suggested change:** Validate that the captured window, including any remembered fallback, is actually an eligible origin on the focused workspace before forwarding it. Preserve copy-only behavior when there is no origin; account for special workspaces and multiple monitors. This guard has not been tested here.

**Verified (source inspection):** Both paste paths now forward the captured address and attempt refocus; calls without an address and copy-only paths retain their previous routing.

---

**Test scope:** Source assessment at `87f3010`, including Hyprland v0.56.2 and Quickshell v0.2.1/v0.3.1 focus handling. Installed Quickshell version and end-to-end desktop behavior were not verified. No stock test-suite result is claimed.
